surfaces.label: CZML document
surfaces.description: Primary current Cesium output from the Python package.

surfaces.label: CesiumJS viewer HTML
surfaces.description: Generated HTML shell that loads CZML in CesiumJS; scene views and richer runtime wiring are not compiled yet.

surfaces.label: CesiumJS loader module
surfaces.description: The imported SDJ workbench has this shape, but the Python package does not emit a dedicated Cesium loader module yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Document metadata
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene id, name, description, source, and created timestamp map cleanly into document packet metadata.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene clock from timestamps
schemaFeatures.notes: Current scene timestamps compile into a CZML document clock.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity point position
schemaFeatures.notes: Entities compile to CZML packets with cartographic degree positions.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity orientation
schemaFeatures.notes: Heading, pitch, and roll are preserved only as packet properties, not native Cesium quaternions.

schemaFeatures.label: Sampled path motion
schemaFeatures.notes: Path objects compile into sampled CZML position plus path graphics with basic styling; richer path semantics remain open.

schemaFeatures.label: Track motion
schemaFeatures.notes: Track objects compile into sampled CZML position plus path graphics, matching the imported SDJ track family closely.

schemaFeatures.label: Rectangle geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Rectangle overlays compile into native CZML rectangle packets with Cesium-compatible bounds and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Corridor geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Corridor overlays compile into native CZML corridor packets with positions, width, and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Ellipse geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Ellipse overlays compile into native CZML ellipse packets with semi-major and semi-minor axes plus styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Circle geometry
schemaFeatures.notes: Circle overlays compile into CZML ellipse packets with matching axes and styling.

schemaFeatures.label: Text labels
schemaFeatures.notes: Style labels compile to CZML label graphics.

schemaFeatures.label: Billboard icons
schemaFeatures.notes: Style icon URIs compile to CZML billboard graphics.

schemaFeatures.label: 3D model references
schemaFeatures.notes: Model URIs compile to CZML model graphics.

schemaFeatures.label: RGBA styling
schemaFeatures.notes: Current point, label, polyline, and polygon paths carry RGBA color into CZML.

schemaFeatures.label: Polyline overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polyline overlays compile to native CZML polyline packets.

schemaFeatures.label: Polygon overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polygon overlays compile to native CZML polygon packets.

schemaFeatures.label: Sensor semantics
schemaFeatures.notes: Sensor entities render as ordinary entities or billboards; no native sensor volume geometry is emitted yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene views
schemaFeatures.notes: The package emits a generic viewer HTML shell but does not compile SDJ view definitions into Cesium camera programs.

schemaFeatures.label: Analysis records
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene analysis content is not compiled into Cesium artifacts yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Presentation records
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene presentation content is not compiled into Cesium artifacts yet.

notes: Current Cesium support is centered on CZML, sampled path/track motion, and a generated CesiumJS HTML loader shell.
The imported SDJ workbench advertises broader Cesium object families than the current Python package actually emits.

surfaces.label: SIMDIS ASI lines
surfaces.description: Line-oriented output for entity-style platform updates; best for simple message or track export, not full scene semantics.

surfaces.label: SIMDIS GOG overlays
surfaces.description: Native overlay surface for polyline and polygon geometry.

surfaces.label: SIMDIS bundle
surfaces.description: Typed bundle containing entities, overlays, diagnostics, and presentation placeholders.

schemaFeatures.label: Document metadata
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene id and counts flow into the SIMDIS manifest, but there is no full scene metadata artifact.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene clock from timestamps
schemaFeatures.notes: Timestamps are preserved on platform updates and trajectories, but no scene-level clock artifact is emitted.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity position
schemaFeatures.notes: Entities map into SIMDIS platforms, sensors, or annotations with position state.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity orientation
schemaFeatures.notes: Orientation is carried for platform lines and bundle state, but not all SIMDIS object paths use it equally.

schemaFeatures.label: Text labels
schemaFeatures.notes: Labels map to platform labels or annotation text.

schemaFeatures.label: Billboard icons
schemaFeatures.notes: Icons are preserved only on annotation bundle entries, not native SIMDIS platform models.

schemaFeatures.label: 3D model references
schemaFeatures.notes: Model URIs are not mapped into SIMDIS model libraries or platform art yet.

schemaFeatures.label: RGBA styling
schemaFeatures.notes: Overlay and annotation colors are preserved, but full SDJ material semantics are not.

schemaFeatures.label: Polyline overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polyline overlays compile into native GOG lines and typed overlay bundle records.

schemaFeatures.label: Polygon overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polygon overlays compile into native GOG polygons and typed overlay bundle records.

schemaFeatures.label: Sensor semantics
schemaFeatures.notes: Sensor entities become sensor bundle records, but current geometry is only a point-like placeholder target.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene views
schemaFeatures.notes: No SDJ view definitions are compiled into SIMDIS presentation records yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Analysis records
schemaFeatures.notes: Analysis content is not compiled into SIMDIS analysis artifacts yet.

schemaFeatures.label: Presentation records
schemaFeatures.notes: The presentation artifact exists but scene presentation content is not compiled into it yet.

notes: The package currently has multiple SIMDIS surfaces: simple ASI-style platform lines, native GOG overlays, and a typed SIMDIS bundle.
GOG is the overlay geometry surface. ASI-style lines are the simple platform update surface. The bundle is the package-owned contract that ties them together.

surfaces.label: SOAP XML envelope
surfaces.description: Single-entity XML surface for transport-style entity updates.

surfaces.label: SOAP scene bundle
surfaces.description: Typed scene bundle with scenario, views, overlays, diagnostics, and placeholder analysis and presentation artifacts.

surfaces.label: ORB-related scenario surface
surfaces.description: ORB text is a related scenario surface in this repo, but it is not yet a first-class target-owned SOAP artifact family.

schemaFeatures.label: Document metadata
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene id and name map to scenario metadata and views, but not all SDJ document fields are preserved.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene clock from timestamps
schemaFeatures.notes: Scene timestamps compile into a scenario clock and trajectory sample times.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity position
schemaFeatures.notes: Entities compile into platforms and optional trajectories with cartographic position state.

schemaFeatures.label: Entity orientation
schemaFeatures.notes: Current SOAP bundle and envelope paths do not preserve scene orientation state as native scenario data.

schemaFeatures.label: Text labels
schemaFeatures.notes: Labels are preserved on sensor swaths and overlay styles, but not as a fully general scene label primitive.

schemaFeatures.label: Billboard icons
schemaFeatures.notes: Icon URIs are not compiled into SOAP bundle or envelope artifacts.

schemaFeatures.label: 3D model references
schemaFeatures.notes: Entities with model URIs emit typed SOAP model records.

schemaFeatures.label: RGBA styling
schemaFeatures.notes: Color is preserved on overlay and sensor style records, but not as a general material model.

schemaFeatures.label: Polyline overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polyline overlays compile into typed SOAP overlay records.

schemaFeatures.label: Polygon overlays
schemaFeatures.notes: Polygon overlays compile into typed SOAP overlay records.

schemaFeatures.label: Sensor semantics
schemaFeatures.notes: Sensor entities compile into typed sensor swath records, but only as point-hosted placeholders today.

schemaFeatures.label: Scene views
schemaFeatures.notes: A typed view and palette artifact is generated, but it is currently derived from the first entity rather than authored SDJ views.

schemaFeatures.label: Analysis records
schemaFeatures.notes: Analysis artifacts are emitted as empty placeholders today.

schemaFeatures.label: Presentation records
schemaFeatures.notes: Presentation artifacts are emitted as empty placeholders today.

notes: The package currently has two SOAP-owned surfaces: a single-message XML envelope and a typed scene bundle.
ORB text exists as a related scenario surface in the repo and should be treated as adjacent rather than identical to the SOAP bundle contract.
